matches_data['away_goals_per_game'] = matches_data['away_score']

away_goals =

away_goals.columns = ['team', 'total_goals_away']

total_goals = pd.merge(home_goals, away_goals, on='team', how='outer').fillna(0)

# Calculate total goals scored per game by each team
total_goals['total_goals'] = total_goals['total_goals_home'] + total_goals['total_goals_away']
